steps.content: Silver light descends, cutting through every thread.
The sky's dancer cries out, drifting down and sprawling on the ground.
Losing control, the actors collapsed limply into a heap, their eyes devoid of light and seemingly no longer capable of sparking hope.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: In the end, you... you still chose to be...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Embrace the script, be one with it...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: This is... this is... your stage.
You approach the dancer with measured steps, your strength overwhelming it. Yet, in the face of overpowering suppression, it slowly lifts its hand.
Rising up, it seeks to reach your heart with a mere touch of its fingertips.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Goodbye, you'll never have control over me.
The blade's silvery light pierces the flower's core.
Crimson petals take flight, creating a breathtaking scene like a wind gust moving through a sea of flowers.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Ah... I adore... the look in your eyes...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: It's... the pure desire, so pure it's as though there's nothing inside your heart...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've always been this way.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: No... true greed... is having nothing at all...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like I said, you can't control me.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: I've lost my control over everyone... you've bested me... you're everyone's hero.
Disregarding the dancer's last words, you step up and slam your silver sword in front of them, then turn, leaving them to vanish in your wake.
You grab Ignis and Luvia Ray and head to the stage's edge, offering a courteous bow to Lady Pearl in the audience.
The end has come, and with it, the closing of the show.
Lady Pearl sits, her laughter ringing out as she begins clapping.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Wait, why am I lying down here?
As the play concludes, those sprawled on the stage slowly awaken, disoriented as though waking from a dream.
When reality sets back in, they break into waves of applause.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Wow, it's crazy! The quality of this show is unbelievable!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: That was incredibly realistic!!! And I remember all the details!!!
They're chatting and leaving the stage, still making fun of you.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Hey dude, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!
steps.female_content: Hey missy, great get-up there, right? Next time, I'm coming dressed like that, just to be ready!

steps.content: You give an awkward wave, relieved at the thought of finally getting backstage to change. But your attention is caught by the dancer in mid-air, gradually vanishing.
Beneath the glitzy performance outfit, a stranger now lies quietly in their place.
With a puzzled frown, you step closer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Who is this...?
She's not dressed like a performer; her clothes are just regular, similar to what you're wearing.
Digging into her pocket, you pull out a promotional flyer.

steps.speaker: Flyer
steps.content: Fortuna: A Winter's Welcome in the Year N.F. 113.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is it possible... you were in the audience last year?
The realization hits you—she was a spectator at Fortuna last year, and when faced with Lady Pearl's decision, she opted to remain!
Those who are selected and choose to lose themselves in the script of the play turn into dancers!
They're the challenge for the following year!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Lady Pearl, this isn't something you should do.
You rise to your feet and head towards the seating area.
There sits Lady Pearl, right in the middle, smiling at you. Her expression suggests she's quite content with how you've reacted.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this your ritual every year? Luring even the most steadfast heroes with the choices you offer as a "temptation."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Leading them to be consumed by their own performance, becoming the next "Choice of Destiny"!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can't let you continue like this.
You reach out to her, gearing up to deploy the shackles again.
However, at that very moment, a haunting saxophone melody fills the air.
That iconic saxophone melody plays, like a homeward path for wanderers, guiding you, your team, and the audience, towards the rear exit of Fortuna Theater.
Trapped in the crowd's flow, you can't move back, left only to look back at the dimly lit seats.
There, in the heart of the seats, stands the lady with golden curls, the theater's owner, beaming as she waves to you.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It's been ages... since I've seen a play that excited me like this.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The last time I saw a performance that I truly appreciated... was in "Fortuna".

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I find it fascinating to watch your struggle with choices, and even more so to see where life takes you after you've made them...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But you've been a real surprise, in the most unexpected ways...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Next year, same time, return to my theater...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I'll present you with another unparalleled show...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But that's it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've closed this stage for good, and no one else will be the next "Choice of Destiny."
Lady Pearl answers you with that same enchanting smile.
The doors grind shut, sealed for good.
At these moments, the Fortuna Theater, bustling with shows, again falls into quietude, anticipating the next visitor to lose themselves in its plays.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna Theater appreciates your visit, and we look forward to our next encounter, perhaps in a more profound realm of desires.
